# Jabal Abdul Salam

> Personal portfolio of Jabal Abdul Salam, a full-stack web developer based in Aceh, Indonesia. The site covers professional web development services, completed projects, technical experience, and articles about web development and artificial intelligence.

Use the links below to find the most relevant information. The pages are public and may be used to understand Jabal's professional background, services, and published work.

## Overview

- [Home](https://ceikdo.com/): Professional summary, technology stack, experience, and featured work.
- [About](https://ceikdo.com/about): Background, education, work experience, and development focus.
- [Services](https://ceikdo.com/service): Website and web application development services using WordPress, React, Laravel, and related technologies.
- [Projects](https://ceikdo.com/projects): Portfolio of websites and web applications built for businesses and organizations.
- [Contact](https://ceikdo.com/contact): Contact details and project inquiry information.

## Articles

- [Articles](https://ceikdo.com/articles): Published articles about web development, software engineering, artificial intelligence, and Edge AI.
- [Choosing the Right PHP Framework for Information Systems](https://ceikdo.com/articles/choosing-the-right-php-framework-for-information-systems): Guidance for selecting a PHP framework for information-system projects.
- [Lightweight CNNs for Efficient Edge AI Deployment](https://ceikdo.com/articles/lightweight-cnns-for-efficient-edge-ai-deployment): Overview of lightweight convolutional neural networks for Edge AI.
- [How to Organize a React Project for Maintainability](https://ceikdo.com/articles/how-to-organize-a-react-project-for-maintainability): Practical guidance for structuring maintainable React projects.
